name: Yori
source:
[i]"You look like you're really troubled. Do you find the idea of marrying me so unpleasant?"[/i]

A steam soldier who maintains order in Itehari as part of the Kurozuru. At a glance, his good looks don't quite match his job, and he has an awful personality in spite of them.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
